blurb: Howdy! Sit back, relax and enjoy 2 more cities in one trip! First we will make a stop to the most popular talked about gas station in the world. Then we we will have a smooth ride to the beautiful San Antonio and have lunch at the Riverwalk! After we spend hours there we will swing by the most beautiful city in Texas! Austin. I'm looking forward to sightseeing you and showing you some of this beautiful state. Deep in the heart of Texas!
